collections.name: Punk
collections.blurb: Studs, chains, crosses and teeth. Built loud.

collections.name: Cult
collections.blurb: Relic buckles, roses and engraved silver. Worship nothing — wear everything.

collections.name: Retro
collections.blurb: Braided suede and sleek clasps from another decade.

products.name: Blood Rose
products.tagline: A red enamel rose set in an antique-silver oval.
products.description: Hand-finished enamel rose buckle on embossed paisley leather. The piece that started the kult. Buckle is detachable, so the strap can be swapped later.
details: Oval zinc-alloy buckle, antique silver finish
Embossed PU leather strap, 3.8 cm wide

products.name: Holy Slab
products.tagline: An oversized brushed cross plate on a triple-row stud strap.
products.description: The loudest thing in the room. A heavy slab-cross buckle on a strap lined with three rows of domed studs. Wear it with baggy denim and a wallet chain.

products.name: Wyvern
products.tagline: A winged dragon with red eyes, coiled across the buckle.
products.description: Sculpted 3D wyvern buckle with red crystal eyes, on embossed black leather. Choose clean, or with a row of studs running the full length.
details: Studded version has a full stud border

products.name: Iron Cross
products.tagline: Slim black strap, cone studs and a cross keeper.
products.description: A slim everyday punk belt: engraved roller buckle, a cross-stamped keeper and an etched tip, with cone studs scattered along the strap.

products.name: Chain Gang
products.tagline: Woven black leather with a hanging chain drop.
products.description: Hand-braided black strap with a western buckle, a fan-engraved tip and a short curb chain hanging from the keeper.

products.name: Braid Cross
products.tagline: Braided black leather with a cross keeper.
products.description: Our braided strap without the chain: an engraved buckle, a cross keeper and a pointed silver tip.

products.name: Fleur Cross
products.tagline: A gothic fleur cross buckle on embossed black leather.
products.description: A compact fleur-cross buckle on tooled leather. Small enough to wear every day, and it still gets noticed.

products.name: Reliquary
products.tagline: A baroque scrollwork oval, made to look like an old relic.
products.description: A domed oval buckle with baroque cross scrollwork, on a riveted black strap.

products.name: Longhorn
products.tagline: A bull-skull plate buckle on a fully studded strap.
products.description: A rodeo plate buckle with a longhorn skull and riders, on an embossed strap edged with studs.

products.name: Dagger Tip
products.tagline: A long engraved blade tip, plus a matching buckle and keeper.
products.description: Western three-piece hardware with a long dagger-shaped tip. Five strap colours, from plain black to leopard.

products.name: Saint
products.tagline: A classic engraved western buckle with a matching tip.
products.description: Floral-engraved silver western buckle, keeper and tip. Works on denim, cargos and over dresses.

products.name: Horseshoe
products.tagline: Wide braided suede with a big brass horseshoe buckle.
products.description: A '70s-style wide braided suede belt with an oversized antique-brass buckle. Soft, chunky, and good over denim or a long shirt.

products.name: Hook
products.tagline: A thin strap with a sculpted silver hook clasp.
products.description: A minimal skinny belt with a polished silver hook-and-loop clasp. Wear it at the waist over dresses, blazers or oversized shirts.
